audience: ML engineers who run models, deployments and training jobs on Baseten

useCases.title: Find unhealthy model deployments
useCases.text: List the models of the workspace, then list the deployments of one model. Open one deployment to read its status and failure reason.

useCases.title: Read recent errors in deployment logs
useCases.text: Read up to 1000 log lines of one deployment, filtered by time, level or text.

useCases.title: Check the replicas and metrics of a deployment
useCases.text: List the replicas of one deployment with their status. Read its current metrics, a summary or a time series.

useCases.title: Compare environments and instance types
useCases.text: List the environments of a model with their promoted deployment. Read the instance types and their prices.

useCases.title: Review the training jobs of a project
useCases.text: List the training projects, then the jobs of one project. Open one job to read its details.

useCases.title: Review workspace audit events
useCases.text: List audit events, filtered by time, text or source such as UI or API. List secret names, which never show their values.
